title: Find Duplicate Records
description:
Write an SQL query to report all the duplicate emails in a table `Person`.

Table `Person`: `id (INT), email (TEXT)`

sample_tests.input:
CREATE TABLE Person (id INT, email TEXT);
INSERT INTO Person VALUES (1, 'a@b.com'), (2, 'c@d.com'), (3, 'a@b.com');

hidden_tests.input:
CREATE TABLE Person (id INT, email TEXT);
INSERT INTO Person VALUES (1, 'x@y.com'), (2, 'x@y.com'), (3, 'x@y.com');

hints: Group rows by email using `GROUP BY email`.
Filter groups with more than 1 occurrence using `HAVING COUNT(email) > 1`.

starter_code.sql:
-- Find Duplicate Records
-- Write your SQL query below
SELECT ...
FROM ...;
starter_code.python:
# Find Duplicate Records (SQL Problem)
# You can test via SQL query or Python
import sys
print('Run query in SQL tab')

reference_solution: SELECT email FROM Person GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(email) > 1;
